{{Quote|These junk dealers must have a weakness of some sort."<br />"Gambling.|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Junk dealers''' played a significant role in the galactic trade market. They were a common sight in most towns and cities and would buy and sell old pieces of technology and equipment.

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was once owned by [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], owner of [[Wald's Parts|Watto's Shop]], a junk dealer from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] junk dealer [[Anniya]] had set up shop on [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the videogame ''[[Star Wars: Yoda Stories]]'', [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] can go to junk dealers who can give him weapons or medipacks in exchange of junk. In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', they are found on all planets, except possibly [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], where they are replaced by [[Wookiee Trading Co.]] employees.
